ui.absente_descriere: Record annual leave, medical leave and special days off for each employee.
absente.tipuri_indiciu: Define special types with their own code and name, then select them when recording days. Deactivation preserves history; the code and category of a used type are protected.

pontaj.celula_invalida: A cell has a date outside the month, a missing employee or an invalid value.

schimburi.completate: Added {{numar}} shifts. Existing configurations were preserved.
schimburi.sursa_initiale: Lab category (prefill): Z7 07–14, S7 15–22, N9 22–07, IN9 22–07, Z12 07–19, N12 19–07 and G24 07–07. All other codes belong to the Custom category; previous settings are preserved, and the initial break is 0 minutes and editable.
schimburi.intrare_indiciu: IN9 is the special 22–07 shift starting on the evening before a weekend or holiday. Record it on its start date, for example Friday for entry into Saturday. The regime distinguishes it without defining premiums or automatic assignments.

ui.reguli_pontaj_descriere: Hour allocation and total column rules.
pontaj.reguli_invalide: Invalid rules. Check sources, selections and factors.
pontaj.reguli_conflict: Settings have changed. Reload before saving.
pontaj.reguli_cod_lipsa: A selected rule code no longer exists. Review Timesheet settings.
pontaj.reguli_indiciu: Choose a source for each column. Undefined rules display —. Factors apply only when explicitly entered; the “200%” label does not enable a premium. Calculations use nominal durations, not elapsed daylight-saving hours. Programs with breaks remain uncalculated until break allocation is specified.
pontaj.atribuire_ZI_INCEPUT: All hours on the shift start date
pontaj.atribuire_ZILE_CALENDARISTICE: Split across calendar days at midnight
pontaj.calendar_indiciu: ZNL and normal hours classify hours by their actual calendar date, 00–24. Start-date mode includes the whole shift in its start month. Calendar mode includes only hours within the report month, including carry-over from the preceding month. Manual hours belong to the selected date.
pontaj.ore_invalide: Enter 0–48 hours with minute precision. Paste accepts hours only, not codes.
pontaj.editare_ore: Select cells, then apply a program or manual hours from the toolbar. F2 / double-click: manual hours.
pontaj.avertisment_dupa_g24: Warning: work scheduled on the day immediately following a 24h on-call shift (G24)

ai.sarcina_activa: The assistant is already working on a request. Wait or stop it.
ai.sarcina_terminata: The AI assistant has finished. The reply is waiting in the assistant screen.
ai.sarcina_eroare: The AI assistant could not reply. Details are in the assistant screen.
ai.propuneri_repetate: Skipped {{numar}} proposals identical to unconfirmed ones above; you can confirm them there.
ai.confirma_cu_butonul: For safety, proposals are confirmed only with the “Confirm and apply” button on the card, where you can see exactly what changes.
ai.luna_de_lucru_indiciu: Requests without a specific month refer to this month; taken from the timesheet.
ui.jurnal_modificari_descriere: Who changed what and when. The log is sealed; a change made outside the application is reported at startup.
jurnal.incident: At startup ({{moment}}) changes made outside the application were found; see the warning above.
jurnal.export_esuat: The export could not be saved: {{detalii}}
pontaj.motiv_obligatoriu: Enter the reason for closing or reopening.
pontaj.redeschidere_amprenta: The fingerprint {{amprenta}}, printed at closing, will no longer match after changes; the next closing computes a new one.
pontaj.luna_redeschisa: The month was reopened for editing.
ui.conturi_descriere: Application accounts: roles, passwords and activation. Visible only to the administrator.
cont.primul_descriere: Pontix now uses accounts. The first account is the administrator: it manages accounts and acknowledges incidents. Existing data stays unchanged.
cont.regula_parola: At least 8 characters, with at least one letter and one digit.
cont.recuperare_descriere: Answer the questions of account “{{nume}}” and choose a new password.
cont.recuperare_administrator: If you no longer know the answers, ask the administrator to reset your password.
cont.salveaza_inainte_de_iesire: Save the timesheet before signing out.
cont.intrebari_impreuna: Questions and answers are filled in together with the person who will use the account; they can change them later in “My account”.
cont.parola_slaba: The password must have at least 8 characters, with at least one letter and one digit.
cont.intrebari_invalide: Choose 3 different questions and fill in all answers.
cont.nume_invalid: The username must have between 2 and 40 characters.
cont.nume_existent: An account with this name already exists.
cont.date_gresite: The username or password is incorrect.
cont.blocat: The account is locked after too many wrong attempts, until {{pana_la}}.
cont.fara_recuperare: The account has no recovery questions; ask the administrator to reset your password.
cont.parola_veche_gresita: The current password is not correct.
cont.ultimul_administrator: The last active administrator cannot be demoted or deactivated.
cont.doar_administrator: Only the administrator can do this.
cont.intrebare_1: Name of the first school you attended?
cont.intrebare_5: First name of your best childhood friend?
cont.intrebare_7: Street you lived on as a child?
cont.intrebare_10: First name of your maternal grandfather?
ui.modificari_nesalvate_inchidere: You have unsaved changes. If you close now, they will be lost.
restaurare.descriere: Replaces the data with a saved copy. The copy is checked first, and the restore is applied when the application restarts.
restaurare.confirma_descriere: The data will be replaced with the copy from {{data}}. Everything changed after that date will no longer appear in the application.
restaurare.sigiliu_inactiv: The copy predates sealing and cannot be checked; it will be sealed when restored.
restaurare.sigiliu_incident: The copy was changed outside the application ({{tabele}}) and cannot be restored.
restaurare.siguranta: The current data is saved automatically as a “before restore” backup, and the restore is recorded in the log.
restaurare.programata: The restore from “{{nume}}” is applied at the next start. Close the application and start it again.
stocare.backup_modificat: The backup was changed outside the application and cannot be restored.
ai.angajat_negasit: No employee matches “{{cautat}}” exactly. Use the badge number or the full name.
ai.angajat_ambiguu: “{{cautat}}” matches several employees: {{candidati}}. Use the badge number.
pontaj.selectie_copiata: The selection was copied to the clipboard.
pontaj.celule_lipite: {{numar}} cells were pasted from the clipboard.
pontaj.gol_titlu: No staff available in this view
pontaj.gol_descriere: To start this month's timesheet, adjust the search filters or import the full list of employees.
dezvoltare.titlu_diagnoza: Local diagnostics, error log & query profiling
dezvoltare.commit_indiciu: Hash of the commit the binary was built from
dezvoltare.eroare: The development details could not be loaded.
dezvoltare.linii_copiate: The last 100 lines of the diagnostic log were copied.
dezvoltare.titlu: Technical details: development, integrity and system
dezvoltare.confidentialitate: 100% offline (medical and personal data stay strictly local, no cloud or telemetry)
dezvoltare.cerinta_cpu: 64-bit x64 processor (quad-core with AVX2 recommended for AI)
dezvoltare.cerinta_ram_minim: 4 GB RAM (base) / 8 GB RAM (with the local AI assistant)
dezvoltare.cerinta_ram_recomandat: 16 GB RAM for smooth switching and inference
dezvoltare.cerinta_disc: 100 MB base application / ~3.5 GB with the local AI engine and model
dezvoltare.cerinta_dependinte: Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime (included in Windows 10/11)
dezvoltare.cerinta_retea: No internet connection required (no outbound traffic)
dezvoltare.izolare_descriere: 127.0.0.1, port chosen at startup, with API key (strictly local, no outbound connections)
planificare.reguli_indiciu: Configure rest, cap and succession rules
planificare.gol_titlu: No employees in this planning selection
planificare.gol_descriere: To set this month's shifts and on-call duties, check the department filters or use the AI assistant.
planificare.reguli_eroare_citire: The rules could not be read.
planificare.reguli_eroare_salvare: The rules could not be saved.
planificare.reguli_descriere: Configure the department's restrictions. Active rules are checked automatically during planning and flagged in the interface.
gantt.suprapuneri_detaliu: periods with at least 2 colleagues absent at once
gantt.in_selectie: in the selected departments and units
gantt.atentie_suprapuneri: Warning: {{numar}} leave overlaps in the same unit.
ai.interval_invalid: The proposal's date range is not valid.
ai.fara_zile: No days left to apply in the range (weekends, leave or absences).
diagnoza.fara_jurnal: There is no diagnostic log for this month yet.
diagnoza.eroare_citire: The diagnostic log could not be read.
pontaj.ultima_modificare_indiciu: From the change log; the full history is in Settings → Change log.
ai.deja_aplicata_reaplica: An identical proposal was already applied above. Confirm only if you want to apply it again.
audit.copie_veche: The database appears to have been replaced with an older copy: it has fewer changes than the application recorded at the last shutdown. If you restored a backup manually, acknowledge the incident; otherwise check who changed the files.
seif.blocat: The data cannot be opened automatically on this Windows account. Use the password of an account or the recovery key.
seif.recuperare_gresita: The recovery key is not correct.
seif.deblocare_descriere: The data was created on another computer or another Windows account. Enter the name and password of an application account, or the recovery key. Later starts will not ask for this again.
seif.cu_cheia: I only have the recovery key
seif.recuperare_descriere: This is the data recovery key. It opens the data if all passwords are lost or if the application is moved to another computer. Without the passwords and without this key, nobody can recover the data.
seif.recuperare_pastrare: Write the key on paper or print the screen and keep the paper in a safe place, away from the computer. Do not keep it in the application folder.
seif.recuperare_retasteaza: Retype the key from the paper to confirm you wrote it down correctly
seif.recuperare_confirma: I have written down the key
seif.recuperare_asteapta_admin: An administrator must write down and confirm the data recovery key before the application can be used. Ask an administrator to sign in.
seif.cheie_noua_descriere: If the paper with the recovery key is lost, generate a new one. The old key will stop working.
seif.cheie_noua_confirmare: The current recovery key will stop working. Continue?
ai.server_necunoscut: The AI engine in the karios\ai folder is not the one shipped with the application and was not started. Replace llama-server.exe with the file from the official package.
ajutor.fara_rezultate: No matching articles. Try another term.
ajutor.fara_acoperire: I have no verified article for this question. Open How to and search by section or describe the operation more precisely. No changes were applied.
ajutor.articol_lipsa: This article is unavailable in this version. Search the current guides.
ajutor.manual_lipsa: This version's manual is not available beside the executable. You can read the steps in this panel.
ajutor.articol.acces.recuperare.pas1: Open the application and sign in; on first use create the administrator.
ajutor.articol.acces.recuperare.pas2: Write down the recovery key and retype it; separators and uppercase letters are automatic.
ajutor.articol.acces.recuperare.pas3: On another computer unlock with your password or key. Use the account questions for a forgotten password.
ajutor.articol.acces.recuperare.rezultat: Access follows unlocking, signing in and confirming the key.
ajutor.articol.acces.recuperare.probleme: Keep the key separately; help cannot recover a lost key.
ajutor.articol.angajati.adauga.pas1: In Employees select Add or Import and check the selected file.
ajutor.articol.angajati.adauga.pas2: Enter employee number, name, contract, hours and schedule category; review the proposed people.
ajutor.articol.angajati.adauga.pas3: Save and check the rows, including activity and department filters.
ajutor.articol.angajati.adauga.rezultat: Saved employees are available in the timesheet.
ajutor.articol.angajati.adauga.probleme: Resolve duplicate employee numbers or unsuitable categories before entering shifts.
ajutor.articol.pontaj.completeaza.titlu: Fill in and save a timesheet
ajutor.articol.pontaj.completeaza.pas1: Choose year, month, people and cells in Timesheet; check the filters.
ajutor.articol.pontaj.completeaza.pas2: Apply a shift or manual hours through Fill and inspect the selected cell.
ajutor.articol.pontaj.completeaza.pas3: Select Save draft and check the success message.
ajutor.articol.pontaj.completeaza.rezult: Values are saved after the save succeeds.
ajutor.articol.pontaj.completeaza.proble: Absences, closed months and outdated revisions may block saving; resolve the displayed message.
ajutor.articol.pontaj.sincronizare.titlu: Synchronize a special shift with Scheduling
ajutor.articol.pontaj.sincronizare.pas1: Select the employee and date in Timesheet and enter an allowed special shift such as S7.
ajutor.articol.pontaj.sincronizare.pas2: Select Save draft; the scheduling position is created or updated.
ajutor.articol.pontaj.sincronizare.pas3: For an older saved special shift, select the cell and choose Update schedule in its details.
ajutor.articol.pontaj.sincronizare.rezul: S7 appears under Afternoon; repeated repair does not create duplicates.
ajutor.articol.pontaj.sincronizare.probl: Save other pending edits first. An independently changed conflicting schedule is protected.
ajutor.articol.planificare.publica.pas1: In Scheduling check month, people and section, then choose a special shift.
ajutor.articol.planificare.publica.pas2: Apply the shift to the intended cells and preview publication.
ajutor.articol.planificare.publica.pas3: Review differences and blocking reasons, then explicitly confirm publication.
ajutor.articol.planificare.publica.rezul: Published shifts appear in the timesheet draft.
ajutor.articol.planificare.publica.probl: Removing a plan does not automatically erase its published draft. Check absences and overlaps.
ajutor.articol.absente.inregistreaza.pas: Open Leave and absences and select the employee and period.
Choose the absence type, complete the request and check days and conflicts.
Save the request; use approval and document attachment separately when needed.
ajutor.articol.absente.inregistreaza.rez: Saved days appear in the calendar and protect timesheet cells.
ajutor.articol.absente.inregistreaza.pro: Check overnight shifts and replacements; contractual leave entitlement does not automatically establish a balance.
ajutor.articol.absente.aproba.titlu: Approve, attach or cancel a request
ajutor.articol.absente.aproba.pas1: Select the request or intended days in Leave and absences.
ajutor.articol.absente.aproba.pas2: Use request / approval details for metadata and attach the required document.
ajutor.articol.absente.aproba.pas3: To withdraw, check the selection and confirm cancellation of the day or selected days.
ajutor.articol.absente.aproba.rezultat: The request and day status reflect the confirmed operation.
ajutor.articol.absente.aproba.probleme: Check registration number, employee and dates before confirming.
ajutor.articol.rapoarte.genereaza.pas1: In Reports choose the template, year, month and filters.
ajutor.articol.rapoarte.genereaza.pas2: Generate a preview and verify people, hours and header.
ajutor.articol.rapoarte.genereaza.pas3: Export PDF or Excel; check printer and pages in your PDF reader before printing.
ajutor.articol.rapoarte.genereaza.rezult: An exported report reflects the data at generation time.
ajutor.articol.rapoarte.genereaza.proble: Regenerate after changing data or filters.
ajutor.articol.rapoarte.defineste.pas1: In Settings → Report templates choose or duplicate a template.
ajutor.articol.rapoarte.defineste.pas2: Configure header, columns, footer and page; check variables.
ajutor.articol.rapoarte.defineste.pas3: Save and check the template with a PDF preview.
ajutor.articol.rapoarte.defineste.rezult: The saved template can be selected when generating reports.
ajutor.articol.rapoarte.defineste.proble: Template changes do not update previously exported PDFs.
ajutor.articol.setari.generale.pas1: Open Settings → General and check full-time hours.
ajutor.articol.setari.generale.pas2: Enter sections and departments before assigning employees.
ajutor.articol.setari.generale.pas3: Save and verify employees and their categories.
ajutor.articol.setari.generale.rezultat: Saved settings are used by subsequent entries.
ajutor.articol.setari.generale.probleme: Payroll rules and percentages must come from accounting, not help.
ajutor.articol.schimburi.configureaza.pa: In Settings → Shifts choose or add a shift.
Enter code, names, start time, duration and regime.
ajutor.articol.schimburi.configureaza.re: An active allowed shift can be used in the grids.
ajutor.articol.schimburi.configureaza.pr: Equal hours do not imply equal intervals: Z7 and S7 both last seven hours.
ajutor.articol.categorii.atribuie.pas1: In Settings → Schedule categories check allowed shifts and the default.
ajutor.articol.categorii.atribuie.pas2: In Employees assign the category to the person or selection.
ajutor.articol.categorii.atribuie.pas3: In Timesheet use By categories, review the preview and save the draft.
ajutor.articol.categorii.atribuie.rezult: Filling respects the category, period and eligible cells.
ajutor.articol.categorii.atribuie.proble: The category must be active and allow the selected shift.
ajutor.articol.sarbatori.verifica.pas1: In Settings → Public holidays select the year.
ajutor.articol.sarbatori.verifica.pas2: Check existing days and use import or list completion when available.
ajutor.articol.sarbatori.verifica.pas3: Save changes and check the timesheet markings.
ajutor.articol.sarbatori.verifica.rezult: The saved calendar is used for filling and validation.
ajutor.articol.sarbatori.verifica.proble: Check imported year and dates; day colors do not establish payment rules.
ajutor.articol.reguli.configureaza.pas1: Open Settings → Timesheet configuration and read each option.
ajutor.articol.reguli.configureaza.pas2: Check allocation of overnight hours and the enabled columns.
ajutor.articol.reguli.configureaza.pas3: Save and verify the result in a test month.
ajutor.articol.reguli.configureaza.rezul: Timesheets and reports use the saved configuration.
ajutor.articol.reguli.configureaza.probl: Do not enter percentages or legal interpretations without accounting confirmation.
ajutor.articol.jurnal.verifica.pas1: In Settings → Change log filter person, month, table or text.
ajutor.articol.jurnal.verifica.pas2: Compare old and new values and check author and time.
ajutor.articol.jurnal.verifica.pas3: Export CSV if needed for review.
ajutor.articol.jurnal.verifica.probleme: An audit incident may block writing; preserve files and have its cause reviewed.
ajutor.articol.conturi.administreaza.pas: Choose an account and check role and activity, or reset the password.
Confirm the change and store the recovery key securely.
ajutor.articol.conturi.administreaza.rez: The account reflects its saved rights and status.
ajutor.articol.conturi.administreaza.pro: Help cannot grant administrator rights or bypass confirmations.
ajutor.articol.backup.restaureaza.pas1: In Settings choose Create backup and check the copy location.
ajutor.articol.backup.restaureaza.pas2: Keep an independent copy of data and the recovery key.
ajutor.articol.backup.restaureaza.pas3: Use the application's restore flow, verify the source and confirm data replacement.
ajutor.articol.backup.restaureaza.rezult: Restore reinstates the selected copy after application checks.
ajutor.articol.backup.restaureaza.proble: Do not copy only the database without its vault or overwrite an open application's data.
ajutor.articol.luna.inchide.pas1: Check timesheets, absences and reports and create a backup.
ajutor.articol.luna.inchide.pas2: In Timesheet select Close month, read the checks and enter a reason.
ajutor.articol.luna.inchide.pas3: Confirm after review; use reopening with a reason for corrections.
ajutor.articol.luna.inchide.rezultat: A closed month is protected against ordinary edits.
ajutor.articol.luna.inchide.probleme: Closing does not replace organizational approvals or payroll rules.
ajutor.articol.ai.foloseste.pas1: For instructions ask 'How do I record leave?'; local help needs no running model.
ajutor.articol.ai.foloseste.pas2: For changes specify people, period and shift and inspect the preview.
ajutor.articol.ai.foloseste.pas3: Apply only with the confirmation button; use New conversation to reset history.
ajutor.articol.ai.foloseste.rezultat: Instructions cite article and version; commands retain validation and confirmation.
ajutor.articol.ai.foloseste.probleme: Missing help coverage is stated explicitly; a question does not apply changes.
ajutor.articol.ai.instrumente.pas1: In AI Assistant open Tools and choose validation, summary, selection explanation or templates.
ajutor.articol.ai.instrumente.pas2: Check people and dates before using a template or CSV export.
ajutor.articol.ai.instrumente.pas3: To undo an applied operation, inspect it and explicitly confirm undo in the dedicated tool.
ajutor.articol.ai.instrumente.rezultat: Tools provide explanations and checks; changes require confirmation.
ajutor.articol.ai.instrumente.probleme: A conflict or closed month may prevent undo; review before repeating a command.
ajutor.articol.conturi.mele.titlu: Change my password and recovery questions
ajutor.articol.conturi.mele.pas1: Sign in and open My account from the user menu.
ajutor.articol.conturi.mele.pas2: Choose password or recovery-question changes and enter the required data.
ajutor.articol.conturi.mele.pas3: Confirm saving and keep recovery information separately.
ajutor.articol.conturi.mele.rezultat: Your account details update after validation.
ajutor.articol.conturi.mele.probleme: Managing other accounts is separate and requires the administrator role.
